added.summary: An icon set's SVG may paint a path in a theme colour, `fill="var(--color-<role>)"` (or stroke): the icon is then drawn in tones, each run of one tone in the pack's colour for that role, over an outline and drop shadow of its silhouette (`sticker <outline> <dx> <dy>` in the set, in 24ths of the em; colours `icon-outline` and `icon-shadow`).
A pack.json's `iconSet` names the icon set (.ogt of type icons) `<Icon name>` draws from under the game's own icons; a later pack layer's set wins by name, so a pack can restyle a few hero icons.
